blockers.description: Reopen evidence: Railway production, read 2026-10-05 via the Railway API: every service (api, ai-worker, events-worker, ingestion-worker, notifications-worker) has `OTEL_ENABLED=false` and no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `ws` has no OTel vars. `infra/terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars` keeps OTel off until `otel_exporter_endpoint` is set, and it is not set. Production exports no traces, metrics or logs.

Reopen evidence: DoD "dashboards and alerts created" / KPI "MTTD actual 1.2min": `infra/monitoring/alert-rules.yml` (25 rules) was never loaded by an alerting system connected to production, and no alert has reached the owner.

To close: (1) Services emit to the hosted backend (IFC-032). Alert rules are loaded there and deliver to the owner. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.
